title: Ring glow in first person: round 2 (860 G1, G2, G3 variations)
desc: You rated 860 G1, G2 and G3 IMPROVE: three new takes of each, built differently. Same rules (nothing on the arm, no panes, saturated green), now brighter-capped so the green stays saturated, and every take reads on the ring's sides, which is what you see in first person.

takes.name: breathing face
takes.facts: G1's face glow = charge, then at full it breathes slowly (+-15%, every 3 s); never static; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: dark core
takes.facts: the face's centre stays dark glass; bright edge lines round it = charge (reads on the sides you see in first person); 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: fills from the centre
takes.facts: lit bars grow from the face's middle to its edges as charge rises, like the lantern's light from the port; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: two lines meet
takes.facts: two rim lines trace both ways from the bottom, meeting at the top at 100%; then one bright segment travels slowly round; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: double rim
takes.facts: outer rim line traces 0-50% charge, a belt round the face's sides 50-100%; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: dashed rim
takes.facts: dark-green dashes round the rim light one by one with charge; at full a slow chase runs round them; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: erratic orbit
takes.facts: 4 pixels on uneven orbits (own radius, speed, wobble), within 2 px of the face; one per 25% charge; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: trailing pixels
takes.facts: each pixel pulls a 2-pixel tail of darker green; slower laps than 860 G3; one per 25%; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: tilted orbits
takes.facts: 2 pairs of pixels orbit on tilted planes round the ring, like an atom; one per 25%; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead
